subject: Consolidating seats + feature bundle options for Q2 renewal
messages:
From: Amelia Brooks <amelia@neonhealth.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jacob Lin <jacob@neonhealth.ai>, Neon Health Procurement <procurement@neonhealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Looking to consolidate seats + bundle features for our Q2 renewal

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from our renewal planning — we have seats spread across three teams (Clinical NLP, Search, and AgentOps) and would like to simplify licensing before our April renewal. High level:~250 active users, peak concurrent ~18 workers (models for embeddings + chat), and heavy use of reranking for Search.

Before we jump into a call, could you send: 
- suggested tier that fits consolidated usage (downgrade vs upgrade tradeoffs)
- an example bundle (what features are included at each tier: KV cache, priority burst, long-context)
- any seat-by-seat crediting or alumni-seat rules (we sometimes move contractors on/off)

Attached is a rough exports file of last 3 months usage.

Appreciate a few options and an estimate of one-time migration credits if we consolidate seats.

Thanks,
Amelia
Amelia Brooks
Director of Strategy, Neon Health
Attachment: neon_usage_summary.csv (csv, 34KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Brooks <amelia@neonhealth.ai>
Cc: Jacob Lin <jacob@neonhealth.ai>, Neon Health Procurement <procurement@neonhealth.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Looking to consolidate seats + bundle features for our Q2 renewal

Hi Amelia — thanks for the file and the context. Quick read-through looks great. I put together three pragmatic options below so you can see cost/feature tradeoffs: 

Option A — Consolidated Standard (recommended for predictability)
- One consolidated seat pool, 300 seat-equivalent license, standard SLA
- Includes basic KV caching, shared prefix cache, API rate smoothing
- No priority burst; good for steady throughput
- Estimated monthly spend: $36k

Option B — Consolidated Performance (for steady peak + rerank heavy)
- 250 seats + priority burst credits (for peak parallelism)
- Long-context support (32k tokens) and higher cache retention
- Add-on: rerank compute credits (metered)
- Estimated monthly spend: $48k

Option C — Elastic Dedicated (predictable latency at lower quantized cost)
- Dedicated pool w/ reserved GPUs, commit pricing (12mo)
- Includes priority routing, on-prem KV options (VPC)
- Best for 24/7 low-latency SLAs; larger upfront commit
- Estimated monthly spend: $58k (with 12mo commitment)

Migration credits: we typically offer one-time credits for multi-team consolidations (range: 5–15% of first-year committed spend depending on contract length). If you share preferred commitment length, I can draft exact numbers.

I attached a brief worksheet (proposal) with line items — will update after you confirm which option you prefer. Would you like a call early next week to walk through numbers?

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: vivek_proposal_20270314.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)

From: Amelia Brooks <amelia@neonhealth.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jacob Lin <jacob@neonhealth.ai>, Neon Health Procurement <procurement@neonhealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Looking to consolidate seats + bundle features for our Q2 renewal

Thanks Vivek — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups: 
1) We're interested in Option B (Performance) but want clarity on the burst credit model: how many burst credits do we get per month and can we roll unused credits?
2) Contractor handling: can we have 10% of seats as "rotating" (contractor) without being counted against the committed seat total?
3) Can you show the one-time migration credit as a line item and the impact across 6/12/24 month commits?

Can you loop in pricing/ops for approvals? We'll aim for a PO by end of March if numbers land.

Cheers,
Amelia

Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Neon Health — Option B ask (bursts, rotating seats, credits)

Team — client (Neon Health) prefers Option B but has three asks: burst credit rollovers, 10% rotating seats exemption, and a migration-credit table for 6/12/24mo commits.

Summary of numbers: estimated ARR (Option B) $576k annualized, typical migration credit band 5–15% initial. If we offer rolling burst credits that can be banked for 3 months it helps them plan but reduces our monthly revenue smoothing.

Questions for pricing ops:
- Is a 10% rotational seat carve-out acceptable contractually? (they will rotate contractors frequently)
- What burst credit bucket sizes are typical for accounts of this ARR? Recommend concrete #s so I can respond.

I attached the proposal I plan to send after approvals.

Thanks,
Vivek

Attachment: vivek_proposal_20270314.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Neon Health — Option B ask (bursts, rotating seats, credits)

Vivek — see notes below, happy to approve once you confirm the final numbers in the worksheet.

- Rotating seats: Approve a 10% contractor carve-out as long as the contract includes a quarterly audit clause and a 30% spike protection (we can re-evaluate if they exceed expected peaks).
- Burst credits: For an ARR ~ $575k, standard bucket is 400 burst credits/mo; allow up to 3-month rollover (up to 1200) but non-transferable and zero cash value.
- Migration credits: approve 10% for 12mo commit, 8% for 6mo, 12% for 24mo (we can flex up to +3% if they sign within 2 weeks).

Please mark up the worksheet with the exact bucket numbers and I will sign off; I'll generate a short approval PDF when you send back the final worksheet.

- Priyom
Head of Pricing Operations
Attachment: approval_note_priyom.pdf (pdf, 6KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Subject: Final proposal: Performance bundle + approved credits (ND-8245)

Amelia — thanks for the quick turnaround. We've locked in the numbers per Priyom's guidance and attached a final worksheet and approval note. Highlights: 
- Plan: Option B — Consolidated Performance
- Price: $48,000 / month (annualized $576k)
- Rotating seats: 10% contractor carve-out, quarterly audit clause included
- Burst credits: 400 credits / month with up to 3-month rollover (max 1200)
- Migration credit: 10% on a 12-month commit (line item in attached worksheet)
- Next steps: send PO referencing deal ND-8245; we'll issue DocuSign and stand up the consolidated seat pool the week after PO clears.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/458392/ND-8245), DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/templates/ND-8245-proposal)

If this looks good I can send the DocuSign today and loop CS for onboarding.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
